{{Quote|I am Jeren Nolus Organa, seventh cousin of our honored duke. It's an honor to meet you.|Jeren Nolus Organa|<ref name="AlderaanBonus">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Bonus Series|Alderaan}}</ref>}}
'''Jeren Nolus Organa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] during the [[Alderaan Civil War]] and a seventh cousin of duke [[Charle Remmot Organa]]. A strong supporter of [[Jace Malcom]], Organa was extremely loyal to him out of respect for Malcolm's sacrifices for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Battle of Alderaan|during]] the [[Great Galactic War]].<ref name="AlderaanBonus" /> During the [[Alderaan Civil War]], Jeren led a small camp of soldiers stationed in the [[King's Pass]]. After the camp was attacked and many, including Jeren, received injuries, he received medical supplies delivered by a Republic citizen.
